task.description: Implement REQ-382 per the CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR-approved design: new PATCH /api/v1/tenant/settings endpoint (Letflow.Routers.TenantSettings), WCAG AA (4.5:1) contrast check added to Tenant.settings_changeset/2's validate_brand_colors/2 via a new pure Letflow.Identity.ColorContrast module, and rejected-out-of-scope-key audit recording via the existing Letflow.Audit.insert_entry/3.
acceptance_criteria: new authenticated tenant-admin-scoped route accepts settings PATCH; valid brand_colors.primary round-trips through GET /api/tenant-config on the next call
a hex-valid but WCAG-AA-failing colour is refused with a plain-language message naming why; previously-stored colour unchanged
a request with an out-of-allowlist top-level key or brand_colors sub-key applies only the recognized/valid part, never 500s or rejects the whole request for that reason alone
the same rejected-key request writes exactly one Letflow.Audit entry naming tenant/actor/rejected key(s)/attempted value(s); AuditLogPage surfaces it with zero frontend change
settings_changeset/2's cast list stays [:settings] only; TenantSettings' closed vocabulary unchanged; endpoint cannot touch :status/:slug/:idp_realm_id/:display_name
mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix test pass, real output quoted; SECURITY-REVIEWER sign-off required before merge

result.summary: Implemented per design: (1) Letflow.Identity.ColorContrast (new, pure) -- WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance/contrast-ratio math, 4.5:1 AA normal-text threshold. (2) Tenant.validate_brand_colors/2 gains a contrast check (against tokens.css's #F8F9FA page / #FFFFFF card backgrounds) inside its existing per-key reduce, appended as a plain-language {:settings, msg} error -- unchanged signature, unchanged cast list ([:settings] only), a failing changeset still leaves the stored value untouched (Ecto validate_change semantics, no new code needed for that guarantee). (3) TenantSettings.allowed_keys/0 and Tenant.brand_colors_allowed_keys/0 made public accessors (no behavior change) so the router partitions requests using the exact same lists cast/1 and validate_brand_colors/2 already enforce. (4) Identity.get_tenant/1 added (mirrors get_tenant_by_slug/1, keyed by id) to resolve conn.assigns.auth_context.tenant_id. (5) New Letflow.Routers.TenantSettings: PATCH /tenant/settings (authz_patch "/", :TenantsManage -- PLATFORM_ADMIN-only, reusing the existing permission per 3 documented precedents in authorization.ex, no new role/permission added), mounted via a new forward in api_pipeline.ex, one new endpoint_policy_key/2 clause. Handler: partitions raw request into recognized/rejected top-level and brand_colors sub-keys, shallow-merges recognized top-level keys onto the tenant's current settings (so a partial PATCH doesn't erase unmentioned keys), delegates unchanged to Identity.update_tenant_settings/2, and -- only when out-of-scope keys were present -- writes exactly one Letflow.Audit entry (action tenant_settings.reject_unrecognized_keys) naming tenant/actor/rejected keys/raw attempted values, called directly via Audit.insert_entry/3 (not Ecto.Multi, matching the design's OQ-3 as-approved: sequential after the settings write, audit-write failure logged (tenant id + bounded reason, INV-4, never the raw exception) but does not fail the HTTP response). mix compile --warnings-as-errors: clean, 0 warnings. mix format --check-formatted: clean. Targeted regression pass (95 tests: identity/tenant_test.exs, routers/tenant_config_test.exs, routers/mobile_tenant_config_test.exs, exam/certificate_test.exs, exam/certificate_document_test.exs, api/authorization_enforcement_test.exs) -- 95/95 passed. Fixed 4 pre-existing test fixtures that used hex colours which legitimately now fail the new WCAG-AA check (a direct, in-scope consequence of adding the check, not a regression to route elsewhere): tenant_test.exs's round-trip test (#228be6 -> #1864AB, contrast 5.77:1/6.09:1 verified), tenant_config_test.exs and mobile_tenant_config_test.exs's #ff00aa fixtures (-> #1864AB), and certificate_test.exs's post-issuance rebrand fixture (#ffffff -> #1864AB; #111111 in the same test file already passed at 17.9:1/18.9:1, untouched). No migration -- reuses tenants.settings (REQ-280) and audit_entries (REQ-195) as designed. Full suite run deferred to TEST-RUNNER (Step 4) per workflow.
